title: Speed Dial
description: One floating button that fans out into the few actions a page is really for.
usage: For app-shaped pages where one verb ("add", "compose") has variants: the button rests at the corner, the actions rise with their labels showing. Three to five actions — a sixth is a menu wearing a costume. Fixing it to the viewport is the page’s job; the part is the cluster.
a11y: The trigger carries aria-expanded and the actions are ordinary buttons, reachable by keyboard in order when open. Labels are text, not tooltips — the name of each action is visible, not hovered into existence.
